name: Immunology and Inflammation (I&I) Benchmark
description: An immunology and inflammation benchmark comprising 35 tasks across 8 diseases aligned with the drug development pipeline, including target discovery, preclinical translation, and clinical applications. It tests translational generalization through cross-species, cross-disease, and cross-platform transfer in data-limited regimes typical of early clinical research.
reputation: A specialized translational biology benchmark with limited but growing use in biomedical ML research, especially for cross-domain generalization in immunology and inflammation.
notes: Includes evaluation of foundation models and statistical baselines; highlights domain-specific model EVA outperforming general-purpose models.
